elements.label: Figure 14
elements.title: Instruments for Building Firms’ Technology Capabilities
elements.content:
A conceptual framework diagram divided into two halves by a vertical dashed line and two levels by a horizontal dashed line:

**Top Categories (orange ovals):**
- Left: "Buiding absorptive capacity"
- Right: "Supporting tech generation, commercialization and transfer"

**Technology Stages (grey ovals, below top categories):**
- Left: "Technology adotion"
- Center: "Technology transfer" (straddling the vertical dashed line)
- Right: "Technology generation"

**Key Actors (grey rectangles along the horizontal dashed line):**
- Left: "Firms"
- Right: "Universities / Research institutions"

**Instruments / Policy Interventions (orange rounded rectangles):**
- Row 1:
  - "Business advisory services" (arrows pointing to Technology adotion)
  - "Technology extension" (arrows pointing to Technology adotion and Technology transfer)
  - "Technology/ R&D centers" (arrows pointing to Technology transfer and Technology generation)
  - "Science/ Technology parks" (arrows pointing to Technology transfer and Technology generation)
  - "Technology Transfer Offices" (arrows pointing to Technology generation and Technology transfer)
- Row 2:
  - "Grants for (process) innovation" (left)
  - "Loans for innovation (equipment)" (left-center)
  - "Open innovation" (center-right, across from vertical dashed line)

Source: World Bank (2019). A Practitioner’s Guide to Innovation Policy.
